projects.name: Archivist
projects.summary: A local-first document research tool for semantic search and exploring personal document collections.
projects.feature: The current build focuses on document indexing and semantic search. The longer-term goal is to make it easier to find information across personal document collections without relying on a cloud service.

projects.name: FrostOS
projects.summary: A fast, easily provisioned 64-bit custom kernel operating system for gamers, everyday users, and fleets, with compatibility layers for Linux and Windows apps.
projects.feature: The kernel bring-up is underway: boot, memory management, and a scheduler tuned for a small number of long-running tasks. The roadmap targets a first release in Q2 2027.

projects.name: Strova
projects.summary: An open source 2D animation engine with Flow, custom brushes, and rapid exporting. Roughly 20x smoother playback on the same hardware.
projects.feature: Strova turns your gestures into animation: draw a stroke or move an object and the motion becomes the animation. Targeting release in Q1 2027.
